title: Signals and Systems, MIT 6.003, Fall 2011
where: MIT OpenCourseWare's official course page at https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-003-signals-and-systems-fall-2011/ provides the syllabus, calendar, readings, 25 downloadable lecture-note PDFs, 25 lecture videos, 14 problem sets with solutions, and exams with solutions. The complete non-video course package is downloadable at https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-003-signals-and-systems-fall-2011/6.003-fall-2011.zip; video files are separately downloadable from the official course download page. MIT OCW publishes the course under its linked Creative Commons license.

notes: The official calendar and lecture-note index agree on 25 ordered sessions, and each session has a corresponding downloadable PDF note and video. The assignments page provides all 14 problem sets and all 14 solutions; Sets 4, 7, 10, and 14 are explicitly optional exam practice. The Fall 2011 assessment set contains three quizzes and a final, each with solutions; older review exams are also available. The readings page additionally supplies a complete eight-chapter open supplementary text by Sanjoy Mahajan and Dennis Freeman, both as one PDF and chapter-by-chapter. The assigned Oppenheim–Willsky commercial textbook is not included, but that omission does not prevent full access to the OCW-authored course corpus. Four coherent shards follow the course's own quiz/final boundaries and keep lecture notes, videos, problem sets, and assessments in teaching order.
